metadata.description: RPD — Rapid Product Document. An AI-agent-agnostic skill covering the full project lifecycle: requirement diagnosis, PRD generation, project state management, security scanning, intent routing, decision drift detection, and cross-session progress recovery. Supports Chinese and English.
metadata.description_zh: RPD — 快速产品文档。面向任意 AI 工具的 Agent Skill：覆盖需求诊断、PRD 生成、项目状态管理、安全扫描、意图路由、决策漂移检测、跨会话进度恢复。支持中英文。

plugins.name: rpd
plugins.description: RPD — Rapid Product Document. Covers the full project lifecycle with three entry flows: new project, half-finished takeover, and continue development. Features include 12 deterministic scripts, 8 security rules, two-layer code-map navigation, and decision drift detection.
plugins.description_zh: RPD — 快速产品文档。三个入口覆盖项目全生命周期：新项目、接手半成品、继续开发。包含 12 个确定性脚本、8 条安全规则、code-map 两层导航、决策漂移检测。
